findings.evidence: `LieAlgebra B (Derivation R A (Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra R A B))` already exists: `instLieAlgebraCoefficients`, Tangent/Lie/Basic.lean:232. Both ingredients are already proved — B-linearity by `derivationCompLinear.map_smul'` (DerivationMap.lean:188) and the bracket law by `derivationComp_bracket` (Tangent/Lie/Map.lean). The PR itself builds a `→ₗ⁅B⁆` this way at SpecialLinear/Tangent.lean:164-167.
findings.fix: Bundle once over the coefficient algebra: make `derivationCompLieHom : … →ₗ⁅B⁆ …` and `quotientLieHom : … →ₗ⁅B⁆ …` (with `lieSubalgebra : LieSubalgebra B`, `quotientLieEquiv : ≃ₗ⁅B⁆`), obtain the B-linear map as `.toLinearMap`, and delete `derivationCompLinear`, `quotientLinearMap`, `quotientLinearMap_apply`, and `quotientLieHom_apply`. Update the R-uses in HopfIdeal/Quotient/Kernel/Tangent.lean (`LieIdeal R` → `LieIdeal B`, `lieIdealSubtypeEquiv`) accordingly.
findings.issue: `derivationCompLinear` (→ₗ[B]) and `HopfIdeal.quotientLinearMap` (→ₗ[B], Tangent.lean:59) are new public bundlings of the same underlying map already public as `derivationCompLieHom`/`quotientLieHom` (→ₗ⁅R⁆), forced only because the Lie bundling is over `R`. The surface now carries two `@[simp]` apply lemmas with divergent normal forms (`quotientLinearMap_apply` → `derivationComp …`; `quotientLieHom_apply_apply` → `algEquivSelf … (d (mkₐ …))`) plus a bridging lemma `quotientLieHom_apply` (Tangent.lean:88) whose only content is that the two agree.

findings.evidence: Contrast `tangentMatrix_apply` (same file, :122-126), `HopfIdeal.quotientLieHom_apply_apply` (HopfIdeal/Tangent.lean:96-102) and `descendDerivation_mk` (:244-250), which all wrap the derivation value in `algEquivSelf`. The synonym is a plain `def … := B` (Tangent/Basic.lean:82) whose intended use is documented at Tangent/Basic.lean:37-39. The defeq leak is visible in the PR: `mem_lieSubalgebra_definingHopfIdeal_iff` closes with a bare `rfl` after `rw [GeneralLinear.trace_tangentMatrix]` (SpecialLinear/Tangent.lean:69-70).
findings.fix: State it as `Matrix.trace (tangentMatrix n d) = Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra.algEquivSelf R (H (R := R) n) B (d (determinantGroupLike R n))`.
findings.issue: `trace_tangentMatrix` equates `Matrix.trace (tangentMatrix n d) : B` with `d (determinantGroupLike R n) : Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra R (H R n) B` with no `algEquivSelf` transport, so the statement is well-typed only by unfolding the synonym; every other public lemma in this API inserts the transport.

findings.evidence: File variables at HopfIdeal/Tangent.lean:53-55 declare `[HopfAlgebra R H]`; the proof body (:134-164) uses only `Coalgebra.counit`, `Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra.algebraMap_apply`/`algebraMap_base`, `Derivation.leibniz` and `Ideal.span_le`. `Bialgebra.CounitAlgebra` is defined for `[Bialgebra R A]` (Tangent/Basic.lean:82). The Main declarations list at :26-33 omits it.
findings.fix: Move it (with its private `derivationVanishingIdeal`) out of `namespace HopfIdeal` to the derivation API under `[Bialgebra R H]`, e.g. Tangent/Basic.lean or Tangent/DerivationMap.lean, and list it in that file's Main declarations.
findings.issue: `HopfIdeal.derivation_apply_eq_zero_of_mem_span` is a general statement about counit-valued derivations — it takes no `HopfIdeal` argument and uses no antipode — yet it is namespaced `HopfIdeal` (so it offers meaningless dot-notation on a `HopfIdeal`) and inherits the file's `[HopfAlgebra R H]`, needlessly excluding bialgebra consumers. It is also missing from the module's Main declarations list.

summary: The PR adds a second, coefficient-linear bundling of a differential that is already public as an R-Lie hom, when a single B-Lie bundling would serve both consumers; and the new `trace_tangentMatrix` states an equation across the `CounitAlgebra` synonym without the transport every neighbouring lemma inserts. I withdraw the earlier request for `@[simp]` on `mem_lieSubalgebra_definingHopfIdeal_iff`: the author's simpNF evidence against it is correct.
